name: search_conversations
description: Search previous conversation history for a specific TOPIC or KEYWORD. Use ONLY when user asks to find conversations about a specific subject, like: 'did I ask about Bitcoin before?', 'when did I mention Flask?', 'show conversations about reminders'. Supports multiple keywords (space-separated or 'term1 OR term2'). For temporal queries like 'what was my last question?', use 'get_recent_conversations' instead.

query.description: What to search for in previous conversations. Supports multiple keywords (e.g., 'video poster' or 'video OR poster') - will find conversations containing ANY of the terms

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return (default: 10)

match_mode.description: Fallback used when the exact phrase is absent. broad (default) matches any non-stop query term for maximum recall. all_terms requires every non-stop query term somewhere in the user query or Jarvis response, reducing noisy multi-word topic matches.

web_conversation_id.description: Optional: filter to a specific web UI conversation by its ID (e.g., 'ebf30410')
